name: Alper Holmberg-Dembele
role: Electronic and physical observation expert — surveillance specialist
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory
description:
Alper Holmberg-Dembele is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 40, the augmentation scarring around his temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Alper Holmberg-Dembele plans to keep it that way. He works as a surveillance specialist out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Alper Holmberg-Dembele describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Alper Holmberg-Dembele is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "I've been watching you for three days. You should close your curtains."
"Information is the only commodity that appreciates with age."
"Everyone thinks they're careful. Nobody is careful enough."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Alper Holmberg-Dembele's reputation — and a price for silence
Alper Holmberg-Dembele discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Alper Holmberg-Dembele intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: As a surveillance specialist, Alper Holmberg-Dembele embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm. Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
